name: 印順
bio_en: Yinshun developed historical studies of Indian and Chinese Buddhism while participating in the reform movement associated with Taixu. His works include The Way to Buddhahood and a study of the history of Chinese Chan. His account of Buddhism for the human realm influenced later Taiwanese Buddhist communities.
